tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: Ma chambre est petite mais jolie.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Qu'est-ce que tu portes au travail ?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. The type of each tile helps: a verb changes for the person (je porte), an adjective matches its noun (une chemise blanche), très goes before an adjective or adverb (très vite), and some short adjectives go before the noun (une petite maison, une vieille église).
The subject tile (je, elle, ils) says who; je becomes j' before a vowel. Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns.
At the end, check with the answer sheet.
